Headline: Promoter Shares of NIMB, SADBL, And PROFL in Auction From Today
Full Content:
The existing promoter of
Nepal Investment Mega Bank Limited (NIMB)
is auctioning 1,58,664 units of shares to existing promoter shareholders from today i.e. 7th Bhadra, 2081.
1,58,664 unit promoter shares of NIMB will be auctioned. Only existing promoters are eligible to bid for the auction within 35 days from the date of publication of this notice, i.e. 7th Bhadra.
All interested shareholders are required to submit their bids at the central office of the bank, conveniently situated in Lazimpat, Kathmandu. If no bids are received from existing founder shareholders within the specified timeframe, the shares will later be open for auction to the general public.
As of writing, NIMB has an LTP of Rs. 278.00. Meanwhile, NIMBPO closed at Rs. 199.90.

Headline: Promoter Shares of PROFL, MLBSL, And NMB in Auction From Today
Full Content:
The existing promoters of
Progressive Finance Limited (PROFL)
are selling its 2,01,867 units of promoter share in an auction from 17th Ashadh, 2081.
2,01,867 unit promoter shares of PROFL are being auctioned to the existing promoter shareholders. Interested individuals are requested to bid for the auction within 35 days from the date of publication of this notice, i.e. 17th Ashadh.
The shareholders should submit their bids at the central office of the company located at Tinkune, Kathmandu. If no bids are received from existing founder shareholders within the specified timeframe, the shares will later be open for auction to the general public.
PROFL closed at Rs. 404.00. Meanwhile, PROFLP has an LTP of Rs. 142.20.
Auction Notice:
The existing promoters of
Mahila Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited (MLBSL)
are auctioning 1,99,472 unit shares to other persons/institutions from today i.e. from 17th Ashadh to 8th Shrawan, 2081.
1,99,472 unit promoter shares of MLBSL are being auctioned. The other persons/institutions are eligible to bid in the auction of MLBSL. Rs. 700 is the minimum bid rate and the minimum bid quantity for promoters’ shares is 100 units. Although bidders can bid for the entire issue, they must abide by the Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity.
Nepal SBI Merchant Banking is the auction manager.
As of writing, MLBSL has an LTP of Rs. 1,919.80.
Auction Notice:
The existing promoters of
NMB Bank Limited (NMB)
are selling its 22,727 units of promoter share in an auction from today i.e. 17th Ashadh to 23rd Ashadh, 2081.
22,727 unit promoter shares of NMB are being auctioned. Interested qualified interested promoter shareholders/general public/institutions are all eligible to bid in an auction. The minimum bid rate is Rs. 120.
NMB Capital Limited is the auction manager. Bids will open at the premises of the auction manager on Ashadh 24 starting at 10 am that day.
As of writing, NMB has an LTP of Rs. 182.20.
